meaning:
Someone descended from Ezrah(?), first mentioned at 1Ki.4.31
§ Ezraite = "a native (as arising out of the soil)"
Ezrahite, of the family of Zerach

elsewhere.note: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations all around.
